tool_input.description: Read comments feature files, mocks, types, authorization

result:
Editing comments is in place in `apps/react-vite`: comment authors see an Edit button that opens a drawer, saving calls a new `PATCH /comments/{commentId}`, and a "Comment Updated" notification appears on success. I didn't run tests, lint, or the app, as you asked.

The lint hook flagged my first version: it called `useNotifications` in the component. I moved the success notification into the mutation hook, as the feature CLAUDE.md requires, and the component no longer imports it. The hook's lint result on the new version was not re-checked by me, since I was not to run lint.

What changed, under `apps/react-vite/src`:

- **API** (`features/comments/api/update-comment.ts`): `updateComment` calls `api.patch('/comments/{id}', { body })`. `useUpdateComment` invalidates the comments list, shows the success notification, then calls any caller `onSuccess`.
- **Drawer** (`features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx`): an Edit button opens a form drawer with the body pre-filled and a required-body check.
- **List** (`features/comments/components/comments-list.tsx`): the Edit button renders beside Delete, only when the comment's author is the current user.
- **Policy** (`lib/authorization.tsx`): new `comment:update` policy that checks only authorship. Admins can delete others' comments but cannot edit them.
- **Mock API** (`testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts`): a PATCH handler that updates the body only when the comment's `authorId` matches the logged-in user, and returns 403 otherwise.

Choices I made that you may want to change:
- Only the author can edit, including admins. I read "the current user's own comments" literally.
- The edit form only changes the body. Discussion ID and author are not editable.

Lint observation, not acted on: `create-comment.tsx` and `delete-comment.tsx` already call `useNotifications` in their components, which the same rule and feature CLAUDE.md forbid. I left them alone because they are outside this change; the hook only checked the files I edited.
